federation.title: Multi-device library
federation.intro: Browse the libraries on your devices together. Each device keeps its own resources; this view is read-only.
federation.cancelled: Query cancelled. Search again to create a new result session.
federation.name.label: Device name
federation.name.tip: Other devices see this name. Up to 64 characters.
federation.localOnly: Open Bakabase on the device whose libraries you want to browse. Multi-device connections are managed from its local window.
federation.scope.label: Search scope
federation.search.label: Name search
federation.search.placeholder: Match a resource name or file name
federation.search.tip: Matches names and file names across the selected devices. Use the local library for advanced property filters. Refreshing starts a new snapshot; devices that reconnect are not silently added to existing results.
federation.availability.label: Files
federation.sort.label: Order
federation.results.partialTip: Devices missing from the coverage were not searched, so their resources are not included in these results. This does not mean they have none. Search again to retry them with a new snapshot.
federation.expired: This result session has expired. The displayed results are kept, but more pages need a new search.
federation.empty.title: No matching resources
federation.empty.partial: No matches on the responding devices
federation.empty.tip: Try a different name or connect another device. An empty local library does not prevent you from browsing other devices.
federation.detail.title: Resource details
federation.detail.readOnly: These values were resolved by the source device. No metadata or playback history is written back from this view.
federation.detail.mediaTip: Playback runs on this device. Linking a file does not guarantee that the source can still read it.
federation.detail.noMedia: No supported media is available for this resource.
federation.devices.title: Devices and sharing
federation.devices.intro: Manage your other Bakabase devices from this window, and share libraries between devices read-only. Sharing is directional: reading another device does not let it read yours, and it never grants management.
federation.devices.empty: No devices connected yet. Enter an address or discover a device to request access.
federation.devices.inbound: This device can read your library
federation.devices.noInbound: Your library is not shared with this device
federation.devices.forgetConfirm: Remove your read access to {{name}}? Its resources and its permission to read you are not deleted.
federation.devices.revokeConfirm: Stop {{name}} from reading your library? Later requests and active media access will be denied. Data already received cannot be recalled.
federation.devices.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Your access to it is removed, its access to your library is revoked, and this device forgets it, including its path mappings and pending requests. Data it already received cannot be recalled. Pair again to reconnect.
federation.sharing.description: Only devices with a separate node authorization can use the new sharing protocol. Existing browser and administrator access settings still apply to the old interfaces.
federation.sharing.unpaired: Existing interfaces may allow unpaired access
federation.sharing.configureRemote: Also set remote access to Enabled and require pairing for existing interfaces. This changes this device’s remote-access settings.
federation.sharing.confirm: Enable read-only sharing of all local resource metadata and supported media with devices you authorize? No device is authorized automatically.
federation.sharing.confirmWithRemote: Enable read-only sharing of all local resource metadata and supported media with devices you authorize? This also sets remote access to Enabled and requires pairing for existing interfaces, so other devices can reach this one. No device is authorized automatically.
federation.sharing.stopConfirm: Stop all node sharing from this device? Existing queries and media sessions will stop working; local management remains available.
federation.sharing.codeTip: Enter this code on the device that should read your library. It is single-use and expires soon.
federation.sharing.codeExpired: This code has expired. Create a new one when needed.
federation.sharing.addressesTip: On the other device, enter one of these addresses under “Connect another device”, together with the one-time code if you created one.
federation.sharing.noAddress: No local network address was found for this device, so other devices cannot reach it yet. Check the network connection, then refresh.
federation.sharing.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled, so other devices cannot use sharing yet. Change it explicitly in local settings.
federation.pair.description: Use a node-sharing code from the other device, or leave the code blank to ask its owner to approve read-only access. Legacy administrator pairing codes are different.
federation.pair.shareBack: Also let the other device read my library
federation.pair.shareBackTip: Turns on sharing on this device if it is off. The other device still has to approve the request; with a code from it, both directions are set up at once.
federation.pair.shareBackTipRemote: Turns on sharing on this device and sets remote access to Enabled with pairing required, so the other device can reach it. The other device still has to approve the request; with a code from it, both directions are set up at once.
federation.pair.directionTip: Without this option, connecting only lets you read the other device; your library is not shared with it.
federation.pair.awaitingApproval: Waiting for the other device to approve.
federation.requests.title: Access requests
federation.requests.replacesExisting: A device with this ID already has access to your library; approving replaces that access. The device name and ID are provided by the requester and are not verified, so check that the address belongs to the device you expect.
federation.requests.offersReciprocal: Approving also lets you read {{name}}'s library
federation.requests.approveConfirm: Allow {{name}} to read all local resource metadata and supported media? This does not give you access to its library.
federation.requests.approveConfirmFrom: Allow {{name}} at {{address}} to read all local resource metadata and supported media? Make sure this address belongs to the device you expect. This does not give you access to its library.
federation.requests.approveConfirmRecipr: Allow {{name}} to read all local resource metadata and supported media? Approving also lets you read {{name}}'s library: this device connects back to it automatically.
federation.requests.approveConfirmFromRe: Allow {{name}} at {{address}} to read all local resource metadata and supported media? Make sure this address belongs to the device you expect. Approving also lets you read {{name}}'s library: this device connects back to it automatically.
federation.mappings.title: Local path mappings
federation.mappings.tip: Map a shared storage root to its location on this device. These mappings are used for playback and opening containing folders on this device; they do not move or copy files.
federation.migration.intro: Bakabase Client is retired. Install the Bakabase desktop app instead: it keeps its own library and can switch its window to any server you manage, with the same full control the client had.
federation.discovery.none: No compatible devices found. You can still enter an address.
federation.discovery.noneFound: No devices found. The other device must turn on sharing on its Devices and sharing page. You can also enter its address above.
federation.error.network: The request could not be completed. Check this device and try again.
federation.error.QueryDeadlineExceeded: The query preparation deadline was exceeded. Try again when the device is available.
federation.error.ScanBudgetExceeded: Reading the library exceeded its scan budget. The device needs more capacity or a revised scan limit.
federation.error.ResultSnapshotTooLarge: The result snapshot is too large. Narrow the name or file filters and search again.
federation.error.Busy: This device is busy. Wait a moment and retry.
federation.error.QuerySessionExpired: The result session expired. Search again to continue.
federation.error.QuerySessionInterrupted: A participating device could not continue this page. Existing results are kept; retry the page or start a new search.
federation.error.CursorSuperseded: This page cursor is no longer available. Start a new search.
federation.error.LibraryEpochChanged: The source library was replaced or restored. Search again; this old resource reference cannot be reused.
federation.error.ResourceGone: This resource is no longer available on its source device.
federation.error.AssetGone: This media asset is no longer available or its session expired. Open its details again.
federation.error.GrantRevoked: Access was revoked. Request a new read-only authorization from the source device.
federation.error.InvalidNodeSignature: Node authorization could not be verified. Reauthorize this device.
federation.error.SharingDisabled: Sharing is disabled on the source device.
federation.error.RemoteAccessDisabled: Remote access is disabled on the source device.
federation.error.CapabilityDenied: This device does not allow this read capability.
federation.error.UnsupportedQuery: A query field or value is not supported. Change the query; unsupported filters are never silently dropped.
federation.error.ProtocolIncompatible: This device needs a compatible Bakabase version before it can join the library.
federation.error.IdentityConflict: The device identity could not be confirmed. Review its address and library identity.
federation.error.InvalidCursor: This result cursor is invalid. Start a new search.
federation.error.RequestTooLarge: This request is too large. Select fewer items or devices.
federation.error.MalformedQuery: The query is invalid. Check its filters and selected devices.
federation.error.PlayerUnavailable: No supported local player could be opened. Use the browser preview or configure a local player.
federation.error.PlayerProxyUnsupported: The current player and proxy settings cannot guarantee a direct connection for this resource. Use the built-in preview, configure a local directory mapping, or install mpv (IINA is also available on macOS), then try again.
federation.error.MediaUnsupported: This browser cannot play the media format. Try a supported local player.
federation.migration.independent: The desktop app's library and settings are separate from Bakabase Client. Uninstall the client once its servers appear in the desktop app's server switcher.
federation.migration.import: Bring connection hints from Bakabase Client
federation.migration.importTip: Preview and save connection hints on this device. Choose an address to request new read-only access. Old credentials are discarded; old directory paths remain hints until you pair and bind current source roots.
federation.migration.rebind: These prefixes are only reminders. After pairing, choose the new shared folder on the device card and bind its local path again.
federation.migration.exportTip: Only needed for a desktop app on a different computer: exports names, addresses and path mapping hints, never administrator keys, cookies, library databases or update settings. On this computer the desktop app imports everything itself.
federation.error.InvalidConnectionHints: This is not a supported connection hint file, or it exceeds the size limits. Export a new hint file from Bakabase Client.
federation.identity.title: Cloned or restored installation
federation.identity.tip: Before starting an installation restored from full AppData, isolate it from the network and keep it isolated until the appropriate reset below is complete. Restoring the same device changes its library generation; a copy for another device needs a new device identity. Do not assume sharing was disabled by the restore. Review legacy remote-access permissions before reconnecting, then enable sharing and authorize devices again. Neither action deletes local library data; browsing must be enabled again afterward.
federation.identity.confirm: For a copied installation on another device: replace both device identity and library generation, clear device connections, path mappings and node grants, and turn sharing and browsing off. Local library data is retained. Complete this on the copy while it is isolated from the network, review legacy remote-access permissions, then reconnect and pair devices again.
federation.recovery.title: Sharing settings could not be read
federation.recovery.description: The multi-device sharing state on this device is unreadable, so it was left untouched rather than overwritten. If you have a backup of the Bakabase data folder, restore the file and retry. Otherwise, reset it with a new device identity: its device connections, path mappings and authorizations are discarded, and sharing and browsing are turned off. Local library data is kept.
federation.recovery.confirm: Replace the unreadable sharing state with a new device identity? Device connections, path mappings and authorizations stored in it are discarded, and sharing and browsing are turned off. Local library data is kept. Afterwards, authorize the devices that read your library again and pair again with the devices you read.
federation.error.NodeUnreachable: This device is unreachable. Check its address and remote access settings.
federation.error.NodeNotAuthorized: No active read-only authorization. Pair with this device again.
federation.error.ProtocolUnsupported: The device uses an incompatible protocol. Update Bakabase on that device.
federation.error.PairingExpired: This pairing request expired. Start a new request.
federation.error.PairingBusy: Pairing is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
federation.error.PairingRateLimited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
federation.error.InvalidAddress: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS device address.
federation.error.SelfAddress: This address belongs to this device. Choose another computer.
federation.error.InvalidNodeResponse: The device returned an invalid response. Check that its Bakabase version is compatible.
federation.error.NodeSessionChanged: The device authorization changed. Start a new search.
federation.error.NodeRedirectRefused: The device redirected this request. Check its configured address.
federation.error.MediaPlaybackFailed: The preview could not continue. Reopen the details to refresh access, check that the source device is online, or try a supported local player.
federation.browsing.title: Browse libraries on this device
federation.browsing.description: Enable browsing to search this library together with libraries you have paired with. This setting does not share your library with other devices.
federation.browsing.disableTip: Turning browsing off closes active searches and previews. Paired devices, directory mappings and sharing settings are kept.
federation.directory.open: Open containing folder on this device
federation.directory.tip: Uses a file on this device or a directory mapping. The source device never opens a window.
federation.error.NoLinkedFile: This resource has no linked file or folder.
federation.error.PathMappingRequired: Configure a directory mapping for this device in Devices before opening this folder.
federation.error.MappedPathUnavailable: The mapped folder is unavailable on this device. Check the mapping and whether the drive is connected.
federation.error.OpenDirectoryUnavailabl: Opening folders is unavailable in this environment.
federation.error.BrowsingDisabled: Browsing is off. Enable it to start a new search or preview.
federation.error.MigrationDraftUnavailab: The connection-hint draft could not be read or saved. Check local browser storage, or clear the draft and import again.
federation.error.PathMappingsChanged: These mappings changed while you were editing. Refresh and review the current mappings before saving again.
federation.error.AssetExpired: Access to this media has expired. Close and reopen the resource details, then try again.
federation.error.MappingChanged: The directory mapping changed while this media was open. Start playback again.
federation.error.UnsupportedPlaybackMode: This media cannot be played that way. Use “Preview here” instead.
federation.error.InvalidPeerResponse: The other device returned an unexpected response. Make sure both devices run compatible Bakabase versions, then try again.
federation.error.InvalidPairingCode: The sharing code is incorrect or has expired. Create a new code on the other device and enter it again.
federation.error.LocalInterfaceOnly: This page only works in Bakabase on this computer. Open it from the Bakabase window on the computer you want to manage.
federation.error.FederationEndpointDenie: The multi-device access policy refused this request. Open this page from the Bakabase window on this computer and try again; if it keeps happening, check the Bakabase logs.
federation.error.InternalError: Bakabase on this device could not complete the request. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the Bakabase logs.
federation.error.SharingStateUnavailable: The multi-device sharing state on this device cannot be read. It was not overwritten; restore it from a backup or reset it below.
federation.error.InvalidDeviceName: Use a device name of at most 64 characters without control characters.
federation.error.NoReachableAddress: This device has no network address the other device could use to read it back. Check the network connection, or clear “Also let the other device read my library” and try again.
federation.migration.draftSaved: Saved as a draft on this device. Importing this file again will not create duplicate hints.
federation.mappings.conflictTip: These saved mappings would be changed or removed. Keep the current mappings or explicitly replace them with the changes shown below. New mappings are retained in either case.
federation.mappings.changedDuringReview: The saved mappings changed. Review the latest values below, then choose again to confirm.
federation.identity.restoreConfirm: For a restored library on the same device: turn sharing and browsing off, change the library generation, and revoke all previous inbound node grants and pending requests/invitations. The device identity, access to other devices and path mappings are retained. Complete this while the restored installation is isolated from the network; review legacy remote-access permissions before reconnecting, then share and authorize devices again.
federation.migration.export.cancelled: Save cancelled; no file was written.
federation.migration.automatic: On a computer with Bakabase Client, the desktop app brings over the client's paired servers — keys and path mappings included — when it starts, so nothing has to be paired again. Its Devices page can run the import again.
federation.switcher.label: Switch device — showing {{name}}
federation.switcher.empty: No other devices yet. Add one under Manage devices.
federation.switcher.openFailed: Could not switch to that device. Check that it is still managed from this computer, then try again.
federation.switcher.listFailed: Could not load the devices this computer manages.
federation.servers.title: Devices you manage
federation.servers.description: Switch this window to another Bakabase device and manage it in full — the same control as sitting at it. Playing files and opening folders still happen on this computer, using the path mappings of each device.
federation.servers.empty: This computer does not manage any other device yet. Add one below, or import the devices Bakabase Client was paired with.
federation.servers.unrestricted: {{name}} lets anyone on its network manage it without pairing. To require pairing, open it, and on its {{page}} page set “{{setting}}” to “{{enabled}}”, then turn on “{{pairing}}”. This computer never changes it for you.
federation.servers.revokedTip: {{name}} no longer accepts this computer — it was revoked there, or its data was reset. Stop managing it and pair again.
federation.servers.forgetConfirm: Stop managing {{name}}? This computer asks {{name}} to revoke it, then deletes its key and path mappings here. Nothing else on {{name}} changes. Pair again to manage it later.
federation.servers.waiting: Waiting for someone on {{name}} to approve — expires in {{minutes}} min. This page updates by itself.
federation.servers.retrying: Could not get an answer from {{name}} on the last try. Still waiting for approval — this computer keeps asking until the request expires in {{minutes}} min.
federation.servers.paired: {{name}} added. Open it to manage it in this window.
federation.servers.requested: Request sent. Approve it on {{name}} under “Let other devices manage this device”.
federation.servers.requestClosed: The request to {{name}} is no longer pending — it was rejected or expired.
federation.servers.import.notFound: No Bakabase Client pairings were found on this computer.
federation.servers.import.done: Imported {{imported}} device(s) from Bakabase Client. {{skipped}} already managed here were left as they are.
federation.servers.import.nothingNew: Nothing new to import: the {{skipped}} device(s) Bakabase Client was paired with are already managed here.
federation.servers.add.title: Manage another device
federation.servers.add.description: Enter the other device's address. With a pairing code from that device it is added at once; without one, a request is sent for someone there to approve.
federation.servers.add.address: Address of the device to manage
federation.servers.add.tip: This is administrator pairing, with full control. It is separate from read-only library sharing below, which uses its own codes.
federation.servers.add.noneFound: No other devices found nearby. You can still enter an address.
federation.servers.mappings.title: Path mappings on this computer
federation.servers.mappings.tip: Where this device's library folders are on this computer. Playing a file or opening its folder runs here and needs a mapping for its folder.
federation.error.ManagedServerAwaitingAp: Waiting for the other device to approve.
federation.error.ManagedServerUnreachabl: Nothing answered at that address. Check the address, and that Bakabase is running on that device with remote access on.
federation.error.ManagedServerNotBakabas: Something answered at that address, but it is not Bakabase.
federation.error.ManagedServerThisAppToo: That device runs a newer Bakabase. Update this app first.
federation.error.ManagedServerServerTooO: Bakabase on that device is too old to be managed from here. Update it first.
federation.error.ManagedServerRemoteAcce: Remote access is off on that device, so nothing can manage it. Turn it on there under “Let other devices manage this device”.
federation.error.ManagedServerThisDevice: That address is this computer. Enter another device's address.
federation.error.ManagedServerCodeReject: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Create a new code on the other device.
federation.error.ManagedServerRequestRej: The request was rejected, or expired before anyone answered.
federation.error.ManagedServerTooManyAtt: That device is refusing more attempts from here for now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
federation.error.ManagedServerPairingUns: That device cannot pair: its Bakabase is too old, or pairing is turned off there.
federation.error.ManagementUnavailable: This installation cannot manage other devices.
federation.error.ServerNotManaged: This computer no longer manages that device. Refresh the list.
federation.error.UnknownServer: This computer no longer manages that device. Switch back to this computer and refresh its list.
federation.error.RelayUnavailable: This computer could not open a local port to show that device. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, restart Bakabase.
federation.error.InvalidRequest: This computer could not read that request. Reload the page and try again.
federation.error.UnsupportedMediaType: This computer did not accept the format of that request. Reload the page and try again.
federation.management.title: Let other devices manage {{target}}
federation.management.description: A paired device gets full control of {{target}} — the same as sitting at it: settings, files and tasks. Pair it with a one-time code from here, or approve its request.
federation.management.loadFailed: Could not read who may manage {{target}}.
federation.management.failed: The change could not be made. Try again.
federation.management.offTip: Remote access is off, so no other device can reach {{target}}.
federation.management.enableConfirm: Turn remote access on for {{target}} and require pairing? Other devices can then pair with a code from here or ask for your approval, and a paired device can manage it in full. Devices that are not paired cannot use it at all.
federation.management.unrestricted: Anyone on the same network as {{target}} can manage it without pairing — change settings, delete files and start programs there.
federation.management.unpairedBrowse: Devices that are not paired can browse and play; only paired devices can manage {{target}}.
federation.management.requirePairingConf: Require pairing for every other device that uses {{target}}? Paired devices keep working; a device that is not paired loses access immediately and has to pair first.
Switch {{target}} from unrestricted access to paired access? Paired devices keep working; any other device or browser loses access immediately and has to pair first.
federation.management.lockOutWarning: This browser is not a paired device, so it loses access too. Make the change from a paired device or from the device itself if you still need this window.
federation.management.addresses: Address to enter on the other device
federation.management.noAddress: No network address was found for {{target}}. Check its network connection.
federation.management.code.tip: One-time pairing code: enter it on the other device together with the address of {{target}}.
federation.management.requests.title: Waiting for your approval
federation.management.requests.approveCo: Let {{name}} manage {{target}}? It gets full control: settings, files and tasks.
Let {{name}} at {{address}} manage {{target}}? It gets full control: settings, files and tasks. Make sure the address belongs to the device you expect.
federation.management.devices.title: Devices that can manage {{target}}
federation.management.devices.revokeConf: Stop {{name}} from managing {{target}}? It is disconnected at once and has to pair again to get back in.
federation.management.devices.revokeSelf: This is the computer you are using. Revoking it ends this window's access to {{target}}; you will have to pair again to manage it.
federation.console.localOnly: This window is showing a device you manage. Multi-device pages belong to this computer's own view.
federation.legacyClient.notice: Bakabase Client is retired. Install the Bakabase desktop app — it brings over your paired servers automatically.
